events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy icon
angles.copy: Eighty-seven years young and still making us laugh! Wishing a very happy birthday to the one and only John Cleese. What's your favourite Python sketch or Fawlty Towers moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' released 58 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' ninth studio album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but known as the 'White Album', was released on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Iconic album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years since The Beatles delivered their iconic 'White Album'. A double LP that broke new ground and still sounds incredible today. Which track is on repeat for you?

events.title: 35 years since we lost Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: November 24, 2026 marks 35 years since the passing of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury.

angles.name: Remembering a legend
angles.copy: Thirty-five years today, the world lost an irreplaceable voice. Remembering the phenomenal Freddie Mercury, whose legacy continues to inspire generations. What's your ultimate Queen anthem?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released 61 years ago
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released in the UK on December 3, 1965, marking a significant artistic shift for the band.

angles.name: A pivotal album
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul', an album that truly changed the game. It’s packed with classics that sound as fresh today as they did in '65. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on
events.blurb: December 8, 2026 marks 46 years since the tragic death of The Beatles' co-founder John Lennon, who would have been 86.

angles.name: Imagine a world
angles.copy: Forty-six years ago today, we lost a true visionary. Remembering John Lennon, whose music and message of peace continue to resonate around the globe.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: January 8, 2027, marks what would have been the 80th birthday of the legendary 'Starman', David Bowie, who passed away in 2016.

angles.name: Remembering Bowie
angles.copy: Eighty years since the birth of an icon. Remembering the extraordinary David Bowie, whose artistry and influence remain as powerful as ever. Which Bowie era is your favourite?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: January 8, 2027, marks what would have been the 92nd birthday of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who passed away in 1977.

angles.name: Long live the King
angles.copy: On what would have been his 92nd birthday, we're celebrating the enduring legacy of Elvis Presley. The King of Rock and Roll forever! What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Led Zeppelin's legendary guitarist and founder, Jimmy Page, celebrates his 83rd birthday today.

angles.name: Guitar god
angles.copy: Eighty-three years of pure rock and roll genius! Happy birthday to the iconic Jimmy Page, the man behind some of the greatest riffs ever. What's your favourite Led Zeppelin track?

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Sir Rod Stewart, the iconic British singer known for his distinctive raspy voice, celebrates his 82nd birthday today.

angles.name: Rock and roll royalty
angles.copy: Happy 82nd birthday to the one and only Sir Rod Stewart! A career spanning decades and a voice instantly recognisable. What's your favourite Rod hit?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Graham 'Suggs' McPherson, the charismatic frontman of British ska legends Madness, celebrates his 66th birthday.

angles.name: Nutty Boy's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the inimitable voice of Madness! From 'Our House' to 'Baggy Trousers', he's given us so many unforgettable tunes. Which one gets you skanking?

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: British blue-eyed soul singer Paul Young, famous for hits like 'Wherever I Lay My Hat' and 'Every Time You Go Away', celebrates his 71st birthday.

angles.name: Soulful celebration
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to the smooth voice of Paul Young! Still got 'Every Time You Go Away' on repeat? We certainly do!

events.title: Dolly Parton would have been 81
events.blurb: January 19, 2027, marks what would have been the 81st birthday of country music legend and global icon Dolly Parton, who passed away in 2026.

angles.name: Celebrating a legend
angles.copy: On what would have been her 81st birthday, we're celebrating the incomparable Dolly Parton. A true legend whose music, wit, and kindness continue to shine brightly.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Take That frontman and acclaimed songwriter Gary Barlow celebrates his 56th birthday today.

angles.name: Pop royalty
angles.copy: Happy 56th birthday to the one and only Gary Barlow! From Take That anthems to his incredible solo work, he's given us so many hits. What's your favourite?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter Billy Ocean, known for his string of 80s hits, celebrates his 77th birthday.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 77th birthday to the incredible Billy Ocean! Get ready to feel like 'Caribbean Queen' and 'Suddenly' dance the night away. What's your favourite Billy Ocean classic?

events.title: 38 years since first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction
events.blurb: January 24, 2027, marks the 38th anniversary of the inaugural Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction ceremony in 1989, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Hall of Fame history
angles.copy: Thirty-eight years ago today, rock history was made with the very first Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. Who do you think should be in the Hall that isn't already?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Take That member and solo artist Mark Owen celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Take That's Mark
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! From Take That's early days to his recent solo work, he's always been a pop favourite. What's your top Mark Owen moment?

events.title: 58 years since The Beatles' rooftop concert
events.blurb: On January 30, 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary final live public performance on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Legendary gig
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles made history with their iconic rooftop concert in London. What a way to go out! Which song from that legendary set is your favourite?

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: English singer, drummer, and songwriter Phil Collins, known for his work with Genesis and a hugely successful solo career, celebrates his 76th birthday.

angles.name: In the Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the legendary Phil Collins! From Genesis to his incredible solo hits, he's given us so many anthems. What's your favourite Phil Collins track?

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Beloved British actor Hugh Grant, known for his roles in romantic comedies and dramas, celebrates his 67th birthday today.

angles.name: Charming at 67
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the ever-charming Hugh Grant! From Notting Hill to Love Actually, he's captured our hearts on screen for decades. What's your favourite Hugh Grant film?

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Multi-talented American singer, songwriter, and actor Justin Timberlake celebrates his 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the Prince of Pop, Justin Timberlake! From *NSYNC to his solo superstardom, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'. What's your favourite JT song?

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Sir David Jason, one of Britain's most cherished actors, famed for roles like Del Boy Trotter and Detective Inspector Jack Frost, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: National treasure
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary Sir David Jason! A true national treasure who has brought us so much joy. What's your favourite of his iconic characters?

events.title: 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died'
events.blurb: February 3, 2027, marks 68 years since the tragic plane crash that killed rock and roll stars Buddy Holly (would have been 91), Ritchie Valens (would have been 86), and The Big Bopper (would have been 97).

angles.name: Remembering the legends
angles.copy: Sixty-eight years ago today, we remember 'The Day The Music Died'. A tragic loss that silenced three rising stars: Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper. Their music lives on.
